instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Plan the person's tasks into their free time and judge their meetings against their pursuits, like an auto-scheduling calendar: ASAP first, then hard deadlines, then what serves their most important pursuit, then due date; tasks wait for their blockers, long tasks split into pieces, hard deadlines may use time outside working hours.", and give it nothing more: every input is optional.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:plan-my-time and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Free time is the weekly schedule in the person's time zone, minus busy events, blocks and work already placed.
